{{Quote|SSIPPLTT! PLTT-T!|The space duck, warning Tana of the Empire|<ref name="kessel" />}}
A [[Duck/Legends|ducklike]] '''individual''' was present on [[Rion/Legends|Rion]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. After the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was [[Devastation of Rion|hit]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] with the [[Ionic Ring Ship]], turning it into an [[Water/Legends|ice]] planet and depriving the locals of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], the feathered being joined a crowd of upset inhabitants demanding to be fed. The duckish individual later alerted [[Tana]], the operator of a local [[Tana's Resort|resort]], that the fugitive [[Mira Volz]] was in danger of arrest by a group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. With the billed being's warning, Volz was able to escape.

==Biography==
[[File:Duckfull.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The space duck, running to warn Tana]]
A ducklike individual was a patron of [[Tana's Resort]], a resort facility that was operated by the [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Tana (Human)|Tana]] on the world [[Rion/Legends|Rion]]. Eventually, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] seized the ''[[Ionic Ring Ship]]'' of noted inventor [[Renn Volz]], which housed a device that could alter the climate of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The Empire wanted to turn the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] on worlds with a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] presence and selected Rion as their first target. The ''Ionic Ring'' [[Devastation of Rion|devastated]] the once-tropical planet, turning it into an [[Water/Legends|icy]] world and freezing the planet's [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] supply. Rion's inhabitants, including the duck-billed being, were driven into desperation. The Empire then demanded the arrest of all Rebels on the planet and sent down [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] for enforcement.<ref name="kessel" />

The Rebel [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] arrived on Rion in his vessel, the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], along with a passenger: Renn Volz's daughter, [[Mira Volz]], who had been on the run from the Empire ever since the capture of her [[Parent/Legends|father]]. Upon the ''Falcon's'' arrival, the feathered individual and a number of other resort patrons stormed the ship, demanding food and bemoaning their plight. Solo was directed towards Tana, who was within her resort. The duckish being followed Solo and Volz into the resort and met with a number of other [[Alien/Legends|aliens]].<ref name="kessel" />

However, the Empire was close behind Volz. The ducklike individual soon left the resort, and while outside overheard another local informing a squad of stormtroopers that Volz was in the resort. The billed being ran back to Tana and warned her of the stormtroopers on the way. Thanks to their alert, Tana was able to help Solo and Volz [[Skirmish on Rion|escape]].<ref name="kessel" />

==Personality and traits==
The ducklike being was loyal to Tana, eager to warn her of any Imperial dangers to her guests. Unlike their fellow locals of Rion, they would not accept the betrayal of Mira Volz to the Empire in exchange for food, even though all of the beings were desperate for it. The duckish individual spoke in a language that was not [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]]. Their body was covered in [[Color/Legends|white]] feathers, aside from their black-colored [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], yellow bill, and yellow lower [[Limb/Legends|legs]] with [[Claw/Legends|clawed]] toes.<ref name="kessel" />

==Behind the scenes==
The space duck was created for [[Russ Manning]]'s comic strip ''[[The Second Kessel Run]]'', published in [[1980]].<ref name="kessel" />
